description:
Hide or unhide a comment on a connected account. THIS CHANGES VISIBILITY on the platform.

Supported platforms: facebook, instagram, youtube, threads. (Not available on linkedin or bluesky.)

Pass commentId and hide (true to hide, false to unhide; defaults to true).

accountId.description: Specific connected account id. Omit to use the first connected account for the platform.

commentId.description: The id of the comment to hide/unhide.

hide.description: true to hide (default), false to unhide.

platform.description: Hide platform: facebook, instagram, youtube, or threads.

name: hide_comment
title: Hide Comment
